descricao_original: The transition from an elastic artery to a muscular one is gradual, so transitional arteries may show features of both arterial types. This section, stained with a trichrome stain, shows an artery in which the tunica media has characteristics of a medium, muscular artery (inner portion of smooth muscle) and a large, elastic artery (outer portion with elastic lamellae). 100x

marcadores.explicacao_original: The tunica media of this transitional artery has characteristics of both medium, muscular and large, elastic arteries. The inner portion shows circularly arranged smooth muscle cells (red) like a muscular artery, while the outer portion contains elastic lamellae (pink) like an elastic artery.
